author: boo2411
body:
Hi, I'm Boo2411 I got banned for spider hacking on 11-20-15. I was not hacking. My brother mattice724 was charging his computer when we were both playing. My computer died and when I turned it back on the screen was frozen and took a few seconds to turn back on. Next thing I new I was banned. I really hope you believe me. Just so you know i have never been banned before in my life.

Thank You,
Boo2411
